intro: Finding Warmth is a humble errand centered on keeping a welcoming hearth fueled with firewood. With the host occupied by other responsibilities, travelers are asked to gather logs so that any soul seeking warmth can find comfort. Completing the task keeps the fire burning and opens the way to further chores.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My hearth is open to warm any soul, but I'd like to ask you to help me if you could.
I simply need more firewood. It is something I would normally do myself, but I have been preoccupied by other tasks.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Light guide you on your tasks.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, perfect. These will do--any that are too wet to use right now I will leave to dry.
Now, if you're willing, I have more tasks I could use help with.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
